adaptation: Exact approved local display font and measured binary axes replace remote font loading.
Variable-axis-type adopts the weight option; width is not offered because the retained fonts have no width axis.
Variable-font-flex adopts its weight option, stagger, carve ease and optical compensation.
Weight-wave keeps the per-character distance crest and slant curve, performing one finite pass per cue.
Caption-weight-shift is adapted as two explicit scene phrases; the spoken caption rail stays verbatim.
Scene entrances and settling are bounded to the normal cue envelope; no GSAP or network loader is introduced.
